list.name: usuario
list.label: Usuario
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT usuario_nombre as __value, usuario_nombre as __text FROM audit_events WHERE usuario_nombre IS NOT NULL ORDER BY usuario_nombre

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', fecha) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE usuario_nombre IN (${usuario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT accion, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE usuario_nombre IN (${usuario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY accion
SELECT usuario_nombre, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE usuario_nombre IN (${usuario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY usuario_nombre ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM fecha) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE usuario_nombre IN (${usuario:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
